name: Taichi
source:
Favourite manga: High School Samurai
Favourite videogame: Queen of Battlers '96
Favourite food: American hamburgers

Taichi is the main protagonist and the player’s character. He’s a young boy from Tokyo who has just moved to the village. At first, he thinks he’s going to miss the urban life he knew before. But meeting Sakura will quickly change his mind…
Taichi is a nice guy, determined, and sometimes a little bit crazy. He likes computers, mangas and loves to have fun with his friends. He is not afraid to face problems, especially when the sake of his friends is involved. Taichi is quite uncertain on big decisions so he usually lets his instinct (or the player!) leading his decisions most of the time…
He got an older sister that is married and still lives in Tokyo.

[Edited from [url=http://kwk.maxlefou.com]official site[/url]]
